faqs.question: Do you follow healthcare cleaning regulations?
faqs.answer: Yes, we strictly adhere to all healthcare cleaning regulations including CDC guidelines, OSHA requirements, and Joint Commission standards. Our team is trained in infection control protocols specific to medical environments.

faqs.question: How often should medical facilities be cleaned?
faqs.answer: Medical facilities require daily cleaning with deep cleaning performed weekly or bi-weekly depending on the type of facility. High-traffic areas and patient rooms need more frequent attention than administrative areas.

faqs.question: What cleaning products do you use in healthcare settings?
faqs.answer: We use EPA-approved, hospital-grade disinfectants that are effective against healthcare-associated pathogens. All products are safe for use in patient care areas and meet stringent healthcare facility requirements.

faqs.question: Can you accommodate after-hours cleaning schedules?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We understand that medical facilities operate around the clock. We offer flexible scheduling including after-hours, weekend, and holiday cleaning to minimize disruption to patient care and staff operations.
